title: Retiming the scripted locomotion episode for the restored 160 cm/s shell

observed_failure.cause: The E60 schedule was authored around the regressed 60 cm/s Stage2 shell. E68 restored 160 cm/s speed coherence, so the unchanged four-second movement integral is now too long.

hypothesis: Shortening only the movement phase durations while keeping total episode duration 10 seconds will preserve non-idle Motion Matching, exact 30-degree turning, stop/settle behavior, and produce a 180-260 cm path.
single_behavior_change: Change only ResolveScriptedLocomotionStep phase boundaries and the per-step turn rate. New schedule: StandingHold 0.0-1.0s; Acceleration 1.0-1.6s from intent 0.1 to 1.0; Cruise 1.6-2.1s at intent 1.0; MovingTurn 2.1-2.4s at intent 0.8 with total yaw 30 degrees; Deceleration 2.4-3.0s from intent 0.8 to 0.05; Settle 3.0-10.0s. Runtime speed, Pose Search, assets, gains, policy, shell authority, stop transition, and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged.
tdd_contract: All six scripted phases are observed.
The phase boundaries match 1.0, 1.6, 2.1, 2.4, and 3.0 seconds.
The moving-turn phase integrates to exactly 30 degrees at the 30 Hz fixed step.
The authoritative Normal path is between 180 and 260 cm.
At least one non-idle animation is selected during Cruise, MovingTurn, or Deceleration without forcing an asset by name.
Stop returns to BalanceActive_Standing and final shell speed is zero.
No human input is consumed or synthesized.
next_if_supported: Run Normal and ZeroActions, evaluate the locked causal locomotion cost, then run the complete 3+3+1+1 causal/control bundle with determinism audit.
